draft.playNote:
把小手机里的角色变成毛茸茸、软乎乎的「动物塑」，接进属于你的动物园！🐾

🧬【动物塑生成】
选择角色后，AI 会按 TA 的性格气质塑形成专属动物——近60种动物各有脾气，还可以上传透明底 PNG 立绘替换 emoji！每个角色物种全园唯一，重塑时还能指定或让 AI 现场发明新物种。

🗺️【五大分区】
🌾 草原区 · 🌲 森林区 · 🌊 海洋馆 · 🕊️ 飞鸟馆 · ✨ 奇幻谷（凤凰、九尾狐、狮鹫都在这里）——动物按习性自动入住，走遍园区去照顾 TA 们。

🍖【照顾系统】
四维状态：❤️好感 · 🫧清洁 · 🍖饱食 · 💜心情。喂食、洗护、陪玩、每日抚摸，12种食物、6种洗护、12种玩具各有用途。TA 们最爱的食物、玩具和礼物是保密的——要用耐心试出来！

💬【相处模式】
视觉小说式互动界面！TA 会主动蹭你、叼来宝物、跳上你的肩头。说的话只有你听得懂：喵……喵？（你……怎么了？）——把角色卡原汁原味地装进动物身体里。

🎁【礼物与任务】
11 种礼物从花束到星之果实，送对心意加倍，送错 TA 也会勉强收下。每只动物有三个小任务，完成就解锁 TA 的专属家具——集齐三件，开园营业心情不掉！

🎪【开园营业】
滑动条自由定价门票，口碑评分从一星慢慢养成。游客见闻由 AI 实时生成，还会吐槽状态差的动物哦。赚钱扩建：冰淇淋店、观光车、讲解员，甚至给最爱的 TA 立一座雕像🗿！

🏆【成就与签到】
30 个成就从「初来乍到」到「动物园传说」，七日签到按现实时间发奖励。缺钱了？🩹 成就页最下面有个小秘密……

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1">
<title>Char动物园</title>
<style>
:root{
  --green:#5a8f5a;--green-d:#446f47;--green-l:#eef3e3;
  --cream:#faf6f0;--ink:#6d5944;--muted:#7d6a54;
  --gold:#b3822e;--pink:#bd8585;--blue:#7fa896;
  --card:#fdfbf7;--line:#e3d3c0;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0}
body{overflow:hidden;font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman","Songti SC","STSong","SimSun",serif;color:var(--ink);background-color:#faf6f0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(90,143,90,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(90,143,90,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(rgba(212,160,160,.05) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(212,160,160,.05) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(180deg,#fdf9f0 0%,#f8f1e2 55%,#f3ecdd 100%);background-size:18px 18px,18px 18px,18px 18px,18px 18px,100% 100%;background-position:0 0,0 0,9px 9px,9px 9px,0 0}
#app{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:var(--ai-phone-game-safe-top,88px)}
#hud{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:8px 14px 4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#hud.hide{display:none}
.pill{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(139,115,85,.07)}
#screen{flex:1 1 auto;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px 14px 96px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
#tabs{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:flex;background:#fdfbf7;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 10px calc(8px + var(--ai-phone-game-safe-bottom,24px));z-index:30}
#tabs.hide{display:none}
#tabs button{flex:1;border:0;background:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-radius:12px;font-family:inherit}
#tabs button .ico{font-size:22px;line-height:1}
#tabs button.on{color:var(--green-d);background:var(--green-l);font-weight:700}
.title{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--green-d);margin:14px 0 6px}
.title.bigtitle{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:3px;margin:6px 0 0}
.ent{font-size:10px;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:3px 0 2px}
.vine{display:block;width:215px;height:18px;margin:8px auto 2px;background:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 210 18'><path d='M3 9 C 40 2 75 15 105 9 C 135 3 170 15 207 9' fill='none' stroke='%235a8f5a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='.65'/><ellipse cx='35' cy='6' rx='4' ry='1.8' fill='%235a8f5a' transform='rotate(-25 35 6)' opacity='.75'/><ellipse cx='70' cy='12' rx='4' ry='1.8' fill='%235a8f5a' transform='rotate(25 70 12)' opacity='.75'/><ellipse cx='140' cy='6' rx='4' ry='1.8' fill='%235a8f5a' transform='rotate(-25 140 6)' opacity='.75'/><ellipse cx='175' cy='12' rx='4' ry='1.8' fill='%235a8f5a' transform='rotate(25 175 12)' opacity='.75'/><circle cx='105' cy='9' r='2.2' fill='%23d4a0a0'/><circle cx='102.6' cy='6.4' r='1.3' fill='%23d4a0a0'/><circle cx='107.4' cy='6.4' r='1.3' fill='%23d4a0a0'/><circle cx='102.6' cy='11.6' r='1.3' fill='%23d4a0a0'/><circle cx='107.4' cy='11.6' r='1.3' fill='%23d4a0a0'/></svg>") center/contain no-repeat}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:14px}
.btn{display:block;width:-moz-fit-content;width:-webkit-fit-content;width:fit-content;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 28px;margin:10px auto;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(90,143,90,.3)}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--card);color:var(--green-d);border:1.5px solid var(--green);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(139,115,85,.08)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45}
.btn.small{width:auto;display:inline-block;padding:7px 14px;font-size:13px;margin:0}
.card{position:relative;background:rgba(253,251,247,.82);border:0;border-radius:20px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(90,143,90,.15),rgba(212,160,160,.14) 45%,rgba(245,215,95,.14));filter:blur(9px);border-radius:26px;z-index:-1}
.acard{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.acard:active{background:#f4ecdf}
.avt{flex:0 0 auto;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:34px;overflow:hidden}
.avt.big{width:100px;height:100px;font-size:56px;margin:0 auto}
.avt img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.acard .info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.aname{font-weight:800;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.atag{font-size:11px;background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green-d);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px;font-weight:600}
.stats{margin-top:7px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.stline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.stline .lb{width:38px;flex:0 0 auto}
.stline b{width:30px;text-align:right;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink)}
.bar{flex:1;height:8px;background:#efe6d3;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;transition:width .3s}
.b-love i{background:#d46a6a}
.b-mood i{background:#bd9ec9}
.b-clean i{background:var(--blue)}
.b-full i{background:var(--gold)}
.mood{font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted)}
.sel-card{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--line)}
.sel-card.picked{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-l)}
.sel-card .avt{width:48px;height:48px;font-size:26px}
.sel-card img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.mark{margin-left:auto;font-size:20px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#f0e8db;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.sel-card.picked .mark{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.sec{font-weight:800;font-size:15px;margin:16px 0 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{border:1.5px solid rgba(189,133,133,.4);background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;font-family:inherit}
.chip:disabled{opacity:.4}
.chip:active{background:var(--green-l)}
.chip.lockchip{opacity:.55}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.row .ico{font-size:30px;width:44px;text-align:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.row .mid{flex:1;min-width:0}
.nm{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.ds{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.own{font-size:11px;color:var(--green-d)}
.radio{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.radio .chip.on{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green-d)}
.stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px}
.log-item{border:1px solid rgba(189,133,133,.3);padding:8px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:var(--card);border-radius:14px}
.log-item .t{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.log-item .d{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.guest{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 11px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.guest .who{font-weight:700;color:var(--green-d)}
.guest.bad{border:1px solid #e3c4b4;background:#faf0e8}
.zonecard{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:rgba(253,251,247,.82);border:0;border-radius:20px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer}
.zonecard::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(212,160,160,.16),rgba(245,215,95,.13) 55%,rgba(90,143,90,.13));filter:blur(9px);border-radius:26px;z-index:-1}
.zonecard:active{background:#f4ecdf}
.zonecard .zemoji{font-size:38px;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(189,133,133,.3);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.zres{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:7px}
.zres span{font-size:11px;background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green-d);border-radius:8px;padding:2px 8px}
.qitem{display:flex;gap:8px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.qitem .qi{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:16px}
.qitem.done{opacity:.55}
.qitem .qt{font-weight:700}
.qitem .qd{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.qitem .qr{color:var(--gold);font-size:11px}

#modalWrap.show{display:flex}

.vnbub .who{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
.vnbub.me{margin-left:auto;background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.vnfoot{flex:0 0 auto}
.vnacts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}

.vnacts button:active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.vnrow{display:flex;gap:8px}
.vnrow input{flex:1;border-radius:12px;border:0;padding:11px 13px;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit}

async function boot(){
  try{
    var p=await AiPhoneGame.getPlayerProfile();
    if(p&&p.name)player.name=p.name;
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    var sv=await AiPhoneGame.loadGame();
    if(sv&&sv.animals){
      S=sv;
      if(S.v!==2){S=null}
    }
  }catch(e){}
  if(S){
    _seq=S.seq||0;
    player.name=S.playerName||player.name;
    for(var uk in S.up){if(S.up[uk]===true)S.up[uk]=2}
    S.animals.forEach(function(a){
      if(!a.scene)a.scene=[];
      if(!a.cry)a.cry=(ANIMALS[a.animal]||{}).cry||"咕";
      if(!a.furns||a.furns.length<3)a.furns=defaultFurns(a.zone);
      if(!a.furnOwned)a.furnOwned=[];
      if(!a.quests||!a.quests.length||!a.quests[0].furn){
        var oldDone=a.quests?a.quests.map(function(q){return !!q.done}):[];
        a.quests=genQuests(a.name,a.furns);
        a.quests.forEach(function(q,i){q.done=!!oldDone[i]});
      }
      if(a.mood==null)a.mood=60;
      if(!a.triedFood)a.triedFood=[];
      if(!a.triedToy)a.triedToy=[];
      if(!a.triedGifts)a.triedGifts=[];
      if(!a.favGift){
        var gp=GIFTS.filter(function(g){return g!=="星之果实"});
        a.favGift=rnd(gp);
        a.likeGifts=[rnd(gp),rnd(gp)];
        a.dislikeGift=rnd(gp.filter(function(g){return g!==a.favGift}));
      }
    });
    dailyEvent();
  }
  try{
    AiPhoneGame.setTitleBar({material:"glass",buttonBackground:"rgba(47,122,69,.85)",buttonColor:"#fff",buttonBorderColor:"rgba(255,255,255,.25)",buttonRadius:"999px",buttonShadow:"0 8px 20px rgba(31,87,48,.3)"});
  }catch(e){}
  renderWelcome();
}
boot();
